other_conditions: The applicant must be a citizen of India.
The applicant must be a ward of a Construction Worker.
The Construction Worker must be registered with the Puducherry Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
The applicant must have secured admission into a higher education program through CENTAC, Puducherry.
benefits_summary: Provides a one‑time grant (₹20,000‑₹1,50,000) for specified professional courses and an annual stipend (₹2,000‑₹4,000) for UG/PG programs.
